translation: Or for stabbing pain in the abdomen, or internal urgency, one should use much Gancao (Licorice); or when one strains to sit and cannot pass stool, it all belongs to blood deficiency; when blood is deficient there is internal urgency, and one should use Danggui (Angelica). For counterflow qi and internal urgency, with the diaphragm and throat not passing and the stool not moving, one should use Shengyang Xiehuo Tang (Raise Yang and Drain Fire Decoction) as the main treatment. (The formula is seen in Lanshi Micang.) For numbness, reversal qi rushing upward, counterflow qi ascending, and hearing and seeing things that are not there, one should use Shengong Wan (Spirit Achievement Pill) as the main treatment.
